fusions.name: Flung Honeycomb
fusions.desc: Flings a dripping chunk of comb at the first enemy in its path for 4 damage, with a 40% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Robbing the Hive
fusions.desc: Swats every enemy within 3 tiles for 10 damage and leaves them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Honey Gorge
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Forager's Wind
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you regain 4 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
